<script>
const currentFilter = 'press-releases';
const newsEventsPageUrl = window.location.pathname;

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const filterButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-button');
    const heading = document.getElementById('page-heading');
    const prContent = document.querySelector('.tab-content-press-releases');
    const evContent = document.querySelector('.tab-content-events');
    const searchFilterField = document.getElementById('search-filter-field');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('news-search-input');
    const hash = window.location.hash.substring(1);

    // Hash-based legacy redirect
    if (hash && (hash === 'press-releases' || hash === 'events')) {
        window.location.href = newsEventsPageUrl + '?filter=' + hash;
        return;
    }

    // Restore the user's last tab when they navigate BACK to this page (e.g. after
    // opening an event, then hitting back) so they don't lose their place. Guarded
    // tightly to avoid hijacking normal visits — all of these must hold:
    //   - no explicit ?filter= in the URL (an explicit link wins),
    //   - the saved tab is 'events' (savedFilter !== 'press-releases'); press-releases
    //     is the default, so there's nothing to restore for it,
    //   - this is genuine back/forward return navigation (see isReturnNavigation), and
    //   - it was saved less than 5 minutes ago (300000ms) — stale intent is ignored.
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (!urlParams.has('filter')) {
        const savedFilter = sessionStorage.getItem('newsFilter');
        const filterTimestamp = sessionStorage.getItem('newsFilterTimestamp');
        const timeSinceFilter = filterTimestamp ? Date.now() - parseInt(filterTimestamp) : null;

        if (savedFilter && savedFilter !== 'press-releases' && isReturnNavigation() && timeSinceFilter && timeSinceFilter < 300000) {
            window.location.href = newsEventsPageUrl + '?filter=' + savedFilter;
            return;
        }
    }

    // Store current filter
    sessionStorage.setItem('newsFilter', currentFilter);
    sessionStorage.setItem('newsFilterTimestamp', Date.now().toString());

    // Scroll to top of panel on search results or pagination, offset for sticky header
    if (urlParams.has('news_search') || urlParams.has('paged') || /\/page\/\d+/.test(window.location.pathname)) {
        var panel = document.querySelector('.news-events-panel');
        if (panel) {
            var header = document.querySelector('header');
            var headerHeight = header ? header.offsetHeight : 0;
            var panelTop = panel.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - headerHeight - 20;
            window.scrollTo({ top: panelTop, behavior: 'auto' });
        }
    }

    function isReturnNavigation() {
        if (performance.navigation && performance.navigation.type === performance.navigation.TYPE_BACK_FORWARD) {
            return true;
        }
        const referrer = document.referrer;
        if (referrer && referrer.includes(newsEventsPageUrl)) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // Tab switching on button click
    filterButtons.forEach(function(button) {
        button.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const filter = this.getAttribute('data-filter');

            // Ignore if already on this tab
            const targetContent = filter === 'press-releases' ? prContent : evContent;
            if (targetContent.style.display !== 'none') return;

            // Update session storage
            sessionStorage.setItem('newsFilter', filter);
            sessionStorage.setItem('newsFilterTimestamp', Date.now().toString());

            // Toggle active button class
            filterButtons.forEach(function(btn) { btn.classList.remove('active'); });
            this.classList.add('active');

            // Update search form for new tab
            searchFilterField.value = filter;
            searchInput.placeholder = filter === 'events' ? 'Search Events' : 'Search News';

            // Determine which content to show/hide
            const showContent = targetContent;
            const hideContent = filter === 'press-releases' ? evContent : prContent;
            const newHeading = filter === 'events' ? 'EVENTS' : 'PRESS RELEASES';

            // Fade out heading
            heading.style.opacity = '0';

            // Fade out current content
            hideContent.style.opacity = '0';

            setTimeout(function() {
                // Change heading text
                heading.textContent = newHeading;
                heading.style.opacity = '1';

                // Swap content visibility
                hideContent.style.display = 'none';
                hideContent.style.opacity = '1';
                showContent.style.display = '';
                showContent.style.opacity = '0';

                // Trigger reflow then fade in
                showContent.offsetHeight;
                showContent.style.opacity = '1';
            }, 200);

            // Update URL without reload (preserve search query)
            const currentSearch = searchInput.value.trim();
            let newUrl = newsEventsPageUrl + '?filter=' + filter;
            if (currentSearch) {
                newUrl += '&news_search=' + encodeURIComponent(currentSearch);
            }
            history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl);
        });
    });

    // On link clicks to pagination, refresh timestamp
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const link = e.target.closest('a');
        if (link && link.href && link.href.includes(newsEventsPageUrl) && link.href.includes('paged=')) {
            if (sessionStorage.getItem('newsFilter')) {
                sessionStorage.setItem('newsFilterTimestamp', Date.now().toString());
            }
        }
    });
});
</script>

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const currentHost = window.location.hostname;

  // Find all links on the page
  const allLinks = document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="http"]');
  
  allLinks.forEach(link => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(link.href);
      if (url.hostname !== currentHost) {
        // Set external links to open in new tab
        link.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
        link.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Skip invalid URLs
    }
  });
});

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const tabLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-link');
    const tabContents = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content');
    function activateTab(tabId) {
        tabLinks.forEach(link => {
            link.classList.remove('active');
        });
        tabContents.forEach(content => {
            content.style.display = 'none';
        });
        const selectedTab = document.querySelector(`.tab-link[data-target="${tabId}"]`);
        if (selectedTab) {
            selectedTab.classList.add('active');
            const selectedContent = document.querySelector(`.tab-content[data-tab="${tabId}"]`);
            if (selectedContent) {
                selectedContent.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }
    }
    tabLinks.forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const tabId = this.getAttribute('data-target');
            history.pushState(null, null, `#${tabId}`);
            activateTab(tabId);
        });
    });
  
    if (window.location.hash) {
        const tabId = window.location.hash.substring(1);
        activateTab(tabId);
      
        const tabsSection = document.getElementById('teamanchor');
        if (tabsSection) {
            tabsSection.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
    }
});
